# Change to FulfillmentOrderSortKeys

DateJanuary 1, 2025

Version[2025-01](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-01)

Flags[Deprecation announcement](https://shopify.dev/changelog?filter=deprecation-announcement)

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

Starting in API version **2025-01**, RELEVANCE will be removed as a valid value from [FulfillmentOrderSortKeys](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2024-10/enums/FulfillmentOrderSortKeys) in the GraphQL Admin API.
